aedĭfĭcĭālis , e, adj.,
I.pertaining to
a building [aedes]: Priamus ad aram Jovis aedificialis confugit (so called because he was worshipped in the building; cf. “Fest. s. v. Herceus, p. 101 Müll.),” Dict. Cret. 5, 12 .
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
